$comment: Model targets for the generators in scripts/. All dimensions in mm; the builders convert to metres on export.

colours.$comment: Working values. Real mouldings vary batch to batch and exact colour matching is not a requirement. glTF baseColorFactor is linear, so use the linear figures, not the sRGB hex.

alc_blue.note: Shares the eurobox blue. The three sampled hex values are the same plastic under different lighting, so they set a range rather than a value; exact match is not required for these models.

units.geometry: four corner posts, shelf decks, front/back beams per level, diagonal side bracing
units.dimension_confidence: Width/height assignment inferred: 1600 takes exactly four 400mm euro containers per level where 2300 divides into nothing sensible, and 2300 is a standard bay height. Shelf count and spacing are estimated, not from a spec sheet.
units.modularity: 600mm depth matches the euro container long side exactly; 1600mm width takes four 400mm-wide containers per level, so 20 per bay across five levels

label_convention.format: EU<long side dm><short side dm><height cm>
label_convention.note: Long side first, so the 600x400x230 is EU6423. This is an internal label convention for our own inventory, not an industry code.
inferred: EU4315 - derived from the convention, not specified
label_convention.alc: ALC<long side dm><short side dm><height cm>, so ALC6441 for the 600x400x415. Inferred to match the EU convention.
label_convention.shelving: SB<n>; the bay carries no moulded label.
